baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional chain joins divorce, substitution, pairing, and comparative good before the participial list.
baseline_models.mechanism: Release opens a slot; substitution can fill that slot with another party or alter the configuration itself; pairing then evaluates the resulting relation as a joined unit and as a type. The focus can therefore stage a better relational arrangement, not only a contest between isolated persons.

activation_trace.role: Release from a restraint supplies the opening of the existing bond as the mechanism's first operation.
One thing standing in another's place supplies literal succession into the opened relational slot.
Change of form without necessary loss of substance keeps reconfiguration alive beside outright replacement.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes the object of evaluation the pairing as well as either member.
A kind or class lets the following participles specify a relational type rather than merely count candidates.
Excellence and selection provide the comparative criterion for the recomposed relation.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens to exchange the addressed wives for individually superior women.
changed_reading.after: The verse also imagines recomposing the pairing: another party may occupy the slot, or the relational form may be remade into a selected, better-working type.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The uninterrupted sequence from muslimat through sa'ihat consists of active-form descriptions rather than an unexplained label of worth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence can function as a repair circuit: de-escalation, trustworthy inward security, disciplined speech, eliciting return, worshipful orientation, and mental spaciousness. These are capacities by which a relation remains correctable, not merely badges possessed before entry into it.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation opposed to war supplies de-escalation as the circuit's opening capacity.
Security, trust, and entrusted reliability supply the stable interior needed after de-escalation.
Prayerful restraint from speech supplies disciplined non-escalation rather than mere silence.
Calling another toward return supplies a reciprocal corrective capacity, not only private remorse.
Worshipful obedience supplies the circuit's governing orientation beyond either spouse's preference.
An expansive, unconfined mind supplies room for the repaired relation to move rather than seize up.

changed_reading.before: The participles are a static devotional resume proving that replacement candidates rank higher.
changed_reading.after: The participles can name interlocking practices that make trust repairable: peace-making, reliability, restraint, mutual correction, worshipful orientation, and spacious movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening legal sequence distinguishes imposing a prohibition from dissolving one and provides a formal release from an oath. Against that sequence, divorce becomes another unbinding operation, while substitution names what can follow the released bond: lawful recomposition rather than arbitrary disposal.

activation_trace.role: Release from restraint anchors divorce as an unbinding operation inside the focus.
Succession into another's place supplies the post-release recomposition.
Prohibition supplies the binding pole against which the nearby releases become legible.
Dissolution of a ban supplies the first explicit reversal from binding to permissibility.
Release from an oath supplies a formal precedent for undoing a binding commitment.
The oath itself supplies the concrete bond to which the preceding release applies.

structural_cues: 66:1 opposes self-imposed prohibition to what has been made lawful, and 66:2 immediately names release from oaths before 66:5's divorce conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, legal release, oath, and focus-level release/substitution; I infer that unbinding enables lawful recomposition, while the live alternative is that 66:1-2 is only legal background and does not modify the marriage clause's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Divorce is a sheer punitive rupture followed by exchange.
changed_reading.after: Divorce participates in a sequence of bounded legal untying: a bond can be released, and the resulting relational vacancy can be lawfully recomposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A secret moves through reporting into exposure, followed by selective acknowledgment and selective turning aside. This makes faith/security and disciplined silence in the focus operational: the better relation is one able to hold entrusted information, disclose accountably, and refrain from totalizing every breach.

activation_trace.role: Trust and entrusted reliability anchor information fidelity in the focus description.
Disciplined restraint from speech anchors containment without making silence absolute.
Concealment in the interior supplies the entrusted-information state at the start of the chain.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies movement of information between parties.
Emergence into view supplies disclosure as the consequence of the report's circulation.
Turning one's side away supplies selective non-pursuit after partial acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 66:3 sequences entrusting a secret, its transmission, divine exposure, acknowledgment of part, and turning aside from part.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealment-report-exposure-discretion sequence and the focus supplies trust plus speech restraint; I infer a household information protocol, while the live alternative is that the focus participles remain general virtues unrelated to disclosure practice.

changed_reading.before: Believing and devout simply intensify generic piety in a replacement profile.
changed_reading.after: Believing and devout also describe information ethics: being trustworthy with what is entrusted, restrained in speech, accountable when disclosure occurs, and capable of proportionate forbearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heart-inclination can become coordinated opposition, but support also expands beyond the couple into patronage and a network of backing. The focus's pairing and trust terms therefore admit an ecological reading: a better pair is one whose loyalties align with a wider sustaining order rather than weaponizing coalition against the bond.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts anchor the model in the quality of alignment within a pair.
Trust supplies the condition under which wider loyalties support rather than destabilize the pair.
Inclination of heart and loyalty supplies the directional variable that can bend a relation.
Strengthening someone with a back supplies both coalition against and backing for a party.
Loving aid and loyal support supply the alternative ecology of aligned backing.

structural_cues: 66:4 expands a two-person conflict into opposed and supporting alignments involving hearts, allies, righteous believers, and angels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-inclination, coalition, and patronal support, while the focus supplies pairing and trust; I infer that relational quality includes alignment within a support ecology, with the live alternative that the support list concerns authority alone and does not redescribe spousehood.

changed_reading.before: Better spouses are self-contained individuals with a superior inventory of traits.
changed_reading.after: A better pairing can be one whose loyalties and supporting ties align instead of turning a wider coalition into pressure against the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to protect self and household from a kindled fire, followed by agents who do not disobey, turns the focus list into preventive architecture. Safety, trust, and responsive obedience are not ornamental virtues; together they interrupt the path by which household disorder becomes fuel.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from harm supplies the protective outcome encoded inside the first listed capacity.
Security and trust supply the stable household condition protection seeks to preserve.
Responsive religious obedience supplies compliance with the protective order.
Driving off harm by protection supplies the explicit preventive action.
A group bound by closeness and belonging supplies the household scale of the mechanism.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive state that the listed capacities are inferred to interrupt.
Departure from obedience supplies the failure mode negated by the context's exemplary agents.

structural_cues: 66:6 moves directly from protecting selves and households to fire and then to agents defined by non-disobedience and enacted command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household protection, kindled fire, and non-disobedience, while the focus supplies safety, trust, and qanut; I infer a causal firebreak from those capacities to prevention, with the live alternative that 66:6 addresses only afterlife discipline and not relational dynamics.

changed_reading.before: The list advertises the private merit of hypothetical replacements.
changed_reading.after: The list also specifies a household safety system: capacities that prevent mistrust and disobedience from accumulating into destructive fuel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of 'perhaps your Lord' follows sincere return and opens into running rivers, advancing light, and a request for completion. That sequence activates the focus's hope-after-interruption, nurture, and flowing movement as a trajectory: rupture need not terminate the story but can expose a route toward repaired and completed life.

activation_trace.role: Hope for milk to return after interruption supplies a latent recovery pattern inside the focus modal.
Gradual nurture, repair, and completion supply the agency that carries recovery forward.
Water visibly flowing over the earth supplies motion rather than a static endpoint to the quality sequence.
The repeated modal carries the same hope-after-cessation image into an explicit return sequence.
The repeated nurturing Lord frame links repair and requested completion across the two clauses.
Unimpeded running supplies an external echo of the focus's flowing-water activation.
Illumination supplies the transformed, guidance-bearing energy toward which the trajectory moves.
Arrival at completion supplies the trajectory's requested culmination without claiming it is already achieved.

structural_cues: 66:8 repeats the focus's عسى رب frame after an imperative and noun of return, then sequences entry, running rivers, moving light, and a plea for completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact frame repetition plus return, flow, light, and completion, while I supply the arrow from marital rupture to a recoverable trajectory; the live alternative is that the later eschatological sequence is only parallel diction and does not redescribe 66:5.

changed_reading.before: The conditional possibility in 66:5 is suspense attached only to replacement after failure.
changed_reading.after: The same possibility can carry a recovery horizon: interruption, nurturing repair, renewed flow, illumination, and completion remain imaginable even when the present relation reaches rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command joins strenuous effort to rough firmness. It activates the focus modal's remote hardness branch and divorce's release branch as a threshold model: hopeful repair and decisive boundary enforcement can coexist, with firmness appearing when effort no longer restores the bond.

activation_trace.role: Hardness and coarseness provide the surprising focus-side branch for a threshold that can become firm.
Release from restraint anchors the boundary's possible enforcement in the focus grammar.
Expenditure of full capacity under hardship supplies sustained effort before or within firmness.
Rough severity in treatment supplies the context's explicit hardening pole.

structural_cues: 66:8 places sincere return and hoped-for completion before 66:9's imperative of strenuous effort and firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repair language followed by effort and firmness, plus a hardness branch for the focus modal; I infer a repair-then-boundary threshold, while the materially live alternative is that the hardness branch of عسى is accidental to the modal and should not affect its reading here.

changed_reading.before: Perhaps softens an otherwise fixed threat into mere uncertainty.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the modal holds both hope and a latent hardening point: repair remains open, yet sustained failure can issue in decisive release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two wife exempla reverse expected transfer through marriage: proximity to righteous partners does not supply fidelity or sufficiency, while proximity to an oppressive partner does not cancel belief or the agency to seek another home. This revises 'better spouses' from inherited status to enacted relational agency.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts anchor the question of what does and does not transfer across a pair.
Trustworthiness supplies an enacted quality that cannot be borrowed from one's counterpart.
An example functioning as admonition supplies the deliberate comparison that tests relational transfer.
Deficient fidelity and trust supply the failure that righteous marital adjacency does not prevent.
Sufficiency supplies what the righteous partners explicitly cannot furnish on another's behalf.
Building by joining parts supplies the believing wife's active request for a differently constituted home.
Nearness and presence supply the requested home's governing relation rather than its current marital association.
Rescue through separation supplies agency that can reject a destructive relational environment.

structural_cues: 66:10 places two unfaithful wives under righteous servants and denies transferred benefit; 66:11 places a believing wife with Pharaoh and gives her a first-person request for another home and rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inverse spouse exempla, failed sufficiency, and active home-building/rescue language; I infer that 66:5 evaluates nontransferable agency rather than borrowed rank, while the live alternative is that the exempla concern final accountability without feeding back into the earlier spouse description.

changed_reading.before: Being a better spouse is a status conferred by association with a superior household or partner.
changed_reading.after: The focus profiles agency no partner can lend: fidelity can fail beside righteousness, and belief can build toward another home from within an oppressive pairing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final exemplar joins guarded chastity, truth-confirmation, and qanut, while the focus places its virgin category only after virtues shared across both coordinated life-history groups. This shifts the ending from a purity climax to a span: divergent histories remain inside one agentive profile.

activation_trace.role: Excellence and selection anchor the question of where the comparative judgment falls.
Devout responsiveness supplies a quality grammatically shared before the status pair divides.
Virginity and lack of prior sexual contact supply one explicit life-history pole without making it the sole excellence criterion.
Guarded sexual integrity supplies the context's explicit chastity feature.
Truthful confirmation supplies an agentive epistemic quality beside chastity.
The repeated qanut quality closes the context by returning emphasis from status to enacted devotion.

structural_cues: In 66:5 the uncatalogued root ث ي ب at word 16 is used only as the uncited structural pole coordinated with أبكارا at word 17, after the shared participles.
66:12 closes with chastity, confirmation, and qanut in one female exemplar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coordinated two-pole ending and an exemplar combining chastity with truth and qanut; I infer that the shared virtues govern both histories, while the live alternative is that the ending merely enumerates two marital-status classes without rhetorically leveling them.

changed_reading.before: Virginity is the list's climactic excellence marker and prior marital history is implicitly lesser.
changed_reading.after: The ending spans rather than ranks histories: virginity is one pole, while the comparative excellence rests primarily in the active virtues shared before both poles.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples remote lactation, labor, nurture, and first-birth branches across a legal-marital sentence. It remains anchored in four exact focus roots and coheres as a cessation-to-renewal sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a generative bodily metaphor, not as the lexical denotation of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence عسى ربه, divorce, and the final firstness term permits a tightly contained interruption-nurture-birth activation.

activation_trace.role: Hope that milk returns after cessation supplies recoverable provision after interruption.
Nurture and gradual completion supply the process that develops renewed life.
Labor contractions supply a painful threshold that can issue in a new configuration.
First offspring or first birth supplies emergence and firstness at the sequence's far edge.

changed_reading.before: Separation only terminates one household and replacement begins another administratively.
changed_reading.after: As a contained metaphor, separation can resemble a laboring threshold through which interrupted provision is nurtured into first life again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because three distant nominal branches briefly assemble a ladder, surface-flowing water, and a rotating pulley inside a virtue list. The image remains focus-anchored and gives the sequence a coherent lifting-and-circulating function; downstream prose should label it an accidental material analogy worth preserving, never a translation or historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three separated list terms activate a compact material system of access, flow, and lifting.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means supplies access and directed ascent within the material analogy.
Water running visibly over the ground supplies the circulating substance.
A rotating pulley supplies the lifting mechanism that turns access and water into a working system.

changed_reading.before: Each descriptor adds one more independent item to a flat catalog.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the descriptors can interlock like an apparatus: means, flow, and repeated lifting make the list functional rather than merely additive.

strongest_changes: The prohibition-release-oath sequence makes divorce and substitution legible as lawful unbinding followed by relational recomposition.
The secret, household-fire, and moving-light sequences turn the participles from a static merit list into information, protection, repair, and completion capacities.
The opposed wife exempla show that fidelity and belief do not transfer through marriage, while the final status pair spans histories under shared active virtues.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings remain live together: legal warning, repair protocol, information ethics, support ecology, household firebreak, regenerative trajectory, and nontransferable agency. The remote branch images also produced contained birth-cycle and water-lifting analogies that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus permits both person-for-person substitution and reconfiguration of the relational form; the packet does not force one to absorb the other.
The reciprocal-correction reading of تائبات depends on the packet's unusually narrow branch for eliciting another's repentance and should remain branch-limited.
Because ث ي ب has no focus branch inventory, the life-history reading uses it only as an uncited structural pole and cannot test its latent branch range.
